items.q: Can you import our bills of materials?
items.a: Yes. We import bills of materials from spreadsheets or your current system, then check them with your team before go-live.
Odoo rolls up the cost of components and operations — materials, labor and machine time — into each unit. The costing method is agreed with your accountant in the Blueprint.

items.q: Do we need tablets on the shop floor?
items.a: Not necessarily. Operators can work from tablets, shared computers or printed work orders. We recommend what fits your shop floor in the Blueprint.

items.q: How do we go live without stopping production?
items.a: We plan the cutover around your production schedule, move open orders and stock at an agreed date, and stay close during {hypercare} of hypercare.
